description.value: You unleash a violent scream charged with the Force. Each creature you choose within 30 feet must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 5d6 psychic damage and 5d6 sonic damage, be deafened until the end of its next turn, and be knocked prone. A success halves the damage and negates the deafness and the fall.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Dark Side Powers, Level 5
